samples.input: In the @divinci-ai/mcp client (McpClient), what is the default value of the `maxReconnectAttempts` configuration option?
samples.target: 5 reconnect attempts before giving up.

samples.input: When a Cloudflare Worker proxies anonymous chat to a Divinci Release (the landing-page pattern), what shared secret authenticates the upstream calls instead of a Divinci API key?
samples.target: A shared HMAC secret, the `LANDING_PAGE_HMAC_KEY`.

samples.input: Which `window` global does the Divinci embed script (embed-script.js) expose by default, and which script-tag attribute renames it?
samples.target: It exposes `window.DIVINCI_AI` by default; set `data-global-name` to use a different name.

samples.input: What do the legacy `/sse` and `/message` paths of the Divinci hosted MCP server return?
samples.target: HTTP 410 Gone (they were retired 2026-08-07); clients must use the `/mcp` Streamable HTTP endpoint.

samples.input: In the @divinci-ai/client SDK, what is the default value of the `wsBaseUrl` (WebSocket origin) option on `DivinciClient`?
samples.target: `wss://live.divinci.app`.

samples.input: For a Divinci Release serving anonymous chat, what is the default value of `maxAnonymousChatMessages`?
samples.target: 1 — it is a per-conversation message cap that you raise for multi-turn chat.

samples.input: What minimum Node.js version does the Divinci CLI (`@divinci-ai/cli`) require?
samples.target: Node.js 22.14.0 or later.

samples.input: Which Divinci workspace API key permission scope gates chat calls such as `chat.create` / `chat.send`?
samples.target: `transcript:write` — there is no separate chat scope, so an explicit permissions array without it gets 403 on chat calls.

samples.input: In the Divinci Server SDK's RAG API (`divinci.rag`), which vector store backs a collection by default?
samples.target: Qdrant; Pinecone serverless (`pinecone-serverless`) can be chosen instead.

samples.input: Of the 33 providers in Divinci's BYOK (bring-your-own-key) system, which two do not accept a workspace BYOK credential?
samples.target: `divinci` and `redis`, because they are platform infrastructure.

samples.input: For Divinci hosted Hermes agents, what is the default per-workspace cap on agents, and when does an agent's container first spin up?
samples.target: The default cap is 10 agents per workspace; creation is lazy, so no container spins until the agent's first chat.

samples.input: On a Divinci Release, what is the maximum length of each conversation starter (the clickable prompts on an empty chat)?
samples.target: 200 characters each.

samples.input: What happens if you set `sttToolOverride` or `pricingTiers` on a Divinci Release while pinned to an older version of `@divinci-ai/server`?
samples.target: The fields are dropped silently rather than raising an error, so you must upgrade the SDK before relying on them.

samples.input: What is the default value of a Divinci release's `localModel` policy for on-device (browser-extension) inference, and how does it behave?
samples.target: `fallback`: use the device first when the extension is present and the visitor's toggle is on, and fall back to the cloud release on any local error.

samples.input: What does the Divinci embed script's `read-aloud` attribute use to speak assistant messages?
samples.target: The browser's own `speechSynthesis` — no server TTS and no cost, and it works for anonymous visitors.

samples.input: Which kinds of failures cause a Divinci Release to fall through to its ordered `fallbackAssistants` chain?
samples.target: Retryable (transient) failures: a provider 429, a 5xx, a capacity or quota error, or a timeout. Refusals, malformed prompts and content-filter blocks do not fail over.

samples.input: For a Divinci RAG vector group attached to a Release, what are the default `mergeStrategy` and `maxChunksPerVector`?
samples.target: `mergeStrategy` defaults to `interleave` and `maxChunksPerVector` defaults to 3.

samples.input: When creating a vector index with `client.rag.vectorIndex.create` in the @divinci-ai/client SDK, which `vectorIndexTool` value is the managed default backend?
samples.target: `vectorize`.

samples.input: What error does the Divinci chat message endpoint return if a request omits both `assistantName` and `replyTo`?
samples.target: `400 bad form data`.

samples.input: Does `client.chat.stream()` in the @divinci-ai/client SDK return an async iterator that can be consumed with `for await`?
samples.target: No. Deltas arrive through the `onChunk` / `onEvent` callbacks, and the returned promise resolves once with the complete message.

samples.input: On the Divinci free plan, which models can be used without attaching a BYOK key?
samples.target: Google-authored and Cloudflare-hosted models; others such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral and Moonshot/Kimi are BYOK-only on the free plan.

samples.input: When a visitor clicks a link-out Divinci Chat CTA card, what parameter is appended to the CTA's `targetUrl`?
samples.target: A `ref=divinci` parameter (the URL opens in a new tab).

samples.input: Which @divinci-ai/client error class is thrown with HTTP status 402?
samples.target: `PaymentRequiredError`, thrown when an x402-priced resource needs payment.

samples.input: How is voice-call usage rounded when Divinci bills a phone call handled by a Release?
samples.target: Each call's duration is rounded up to the whole minute, so a 61-second call bills as 2 minutes.

samples.input: When enabling automatic re-sync of an e-commerce product catalog in Divinci's Feed Digester, which intervals can be chosen?
samples.target: 6 hours, 12 hours, daily, or weekly.

samples.input: Does the @divinci-ai/client SDK automatically refresh a `userToken` passed to `DivinciClient`?
samples.target: No. It is sent verbatim as the Bearer value; the client has no built-in refresh logic, so it must be a short-lived access token.

samples.input: When setting up the open-source Divinci demo pipeline with the Divinci CLI, why must `DIVINCI_API_KEY` be left unset?
samples.target: Workspace creation needs the OAuth session, and the CLI prefers an API key over OAuth whenever one is present, so a key in the shell breaks `divinci workspace create`.

samples.input: In the Divinci Docs workflow, what does the `--swap` flag do on `divinci connectors web-crawl`?
samples.target: The new crawl is built alongside the live vector and swapped in only on success, so a failed re-crawl leaves the previous corpus in place.

samples.input: How many probes and attack classes make up Divinci's red-team corpus, and how many probes at most go into one billed request?
samples.target: 32 probes in seven classes; each class is one billed request of at most six probes.

samples.input: Which event does the Divinci MCP server push when its resource catalog changes?
samples.target: `notifications/resources/list_changed`, which the @divinci-ai/mcp client surfaces via `onResourcesChanged`.

samples.input: In the @divinci-ai/server SDK's x402 payments, what does the wallet sign when a call returns 402?
samples.target: An EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` for the exact amount required; it does not broadcast, and the request is retried with the `X-PAYMENT` header.

samples.input: What is the default `DAILY_GLOBAL_USD` limit in the Divinci Server SDK's Spend Guard?
samples.target: $50 per day platform-wide (a development default).

samples.input: Where does the @divinci-ai/mcp client keep Auth0 tokens by default?
samples.target: In memory, so they are lost on page reload; supply a custom `TokenStorage` to persist them.

samples.input: When publishing a Divinci release as its own MCP server, what must be configured before `allowAnonymousMcp` can be enabled?
samples.target: A positive `maxSpendPerTokenCents` spend cap; anonymous access without a spend cap is rejected.

samples.input: Which `divinci hermes update` flag removes a hosted Hermes agent's BYOK provider key and reverts it to platform billing?
samples.target: `--clear-provider-key`.

samples.input: What happens if a Divinci release update body includes the old `toolRouting` object?
samples.target: It still returns 200 and changes nothing, because tool routing was merged into `skillConfig` and the update route ignores unknown keys.

samples.input: Which workspace setting restricts which origins can load an embedded Divinci Release?
samples.target: `allowedDomains`; an unset allowlist is not origin-restricted.

samples.input: Is Llama Guard harmful-message moderation on or off by default for a Divinci Release?
samples.target: On by default (`noHarmful.on: true`) — it is opt-out, unlike the other moderation controls.

samples.input: Which of Divinci's three caching layers skips the entire turn, including RAG, moderation, escrow and the LLM call?
samples.target: The Redis response-level semantic cache (off by default, anonymous/public chat only).

samples.input: When de-identification is enabled on a Divinci Release, is the original un-redacted message text archived?
samples.target: No — it is discarded, not archived, so a redacted message cannot be un-redacted later.

samples.input: In Divinci Scored QA calibration, which statistics measure agreement between human raters and LLM judges?
samples.target: Spearman's rho and Quadratic Weighted Kappa; the highest-correlation judge becomes the workspace default.

samples.input: In the Divinci Server SDK's Site Converter (`divinci.siteToCode.createAndWait`), what is the maximum number of `pageUrls` that can be converted?
What is the default polling timeout for `divinci trust run` (TrustBench) in the Divinci CLI?
samples.target: 600 seconds.

samples.input: In Divinci's web scraping cascade, which tool is tried first as the cheapest option?
samples.target: `@divinci-ai/fetch-scraper`, a plain HTTP fetch.

samples.input: Why is Divinci's `@divinci-ai/openparse` parser deprecated, and what should be used instead?
samples.target: It hit memory limits on large PDFs; LangExtract replaces it.

samples.input: In Divinci's bring-your-own retriever contract, what range must each result's `score` fall in?
samples.target: 0–1; unbounded scores such as BM25 must be squashed monotonically before returning.

samples.input: Which Divinci embedding model is recommended for catalog imports and batches of more than ~100 files?
samples.target: `gemini-embedding-001@1536` (~100K requests/min, batched).

samples.input: Which base models can be fine-tuned through the Cloudflare Workers AI LoRA backend in Divinci?
samples.target: Gemma 3 12B IT and Mistral Small 3.1 24B Instruct.

samples.input: How does Divinci's `stanford` de-identification engine handle the `hybrid` strategy?
samples.target: It treats `hybrid` as plain `redact` (only the default `presidio` engine implements the real mix).

samples.input: In `@divinci-ai/extension-bridge`, what does `chat()` do when the Divinci Local Inference extension is not installed?
samples.target: It falls back to the supplied `cloudChat`, or rejects if no `cloudChat` was supplied.

samples.input: Which post types does the Divinci WordPress connector (`divinci connectors wordpress`) ingest by default?
samples.target: `posts,pages` (set other `rest_base` values with `--post-types`).

samples.input: What is the default page limit for `divinci connectors web-crawl`?
samples.target: 80 pages (`--limit`).

samples.input: Do a Divinci API key's `transcript:read` / `transcript:write` scopes grant access to tools over the Divinci MCP server (e.g. from n8n or Make)?
samples.target: No. They are not MCP scope names, so they contribute no MCP access even though they are the chat scopes for the REST API.

samples.input: What happens if you trigger a Divinci connector sync while a sync job for that connection is already running?
samples.target: You get a 409 with the running job's id.

samples.input: What is the default `dailyRequestBudget` for the Divinci Practice Better connector?
samples.target: 2000 API calls per day.

samples.input: When does Divinci renew a Google Drive connector's `changes.watch` push channel?
samples.target: Within 12 hours of it lapsing; if registration or renewal fails, the connection falls back to polling.

samples.input: For the Divinci Cloudflare R2 connector, what value does the `endpoint` credential field expect?
samples.target: Your Cloudflare account ID, not a URL.

samples.input: Per the Divinci changelog of August 11, 2026, what is the daily file upload cap on the free and premium plans?
samples.target: 50 files per day on free and 100 on premium, now also applied to bulk uploads.

samples.input: In Divinci, what happens to a chat turn in a HIPAA-scoped workspace if the model provider is not covered by a business associate agreement?
samples.target: The turn is refused; HIPAA-scoped protections cannot be switched off once enabled.

samples.input: Per the Divinci changelog (August 12, 2026), what intervals can a hosted Hermes agent's proactive loop run on?
samples.target: Every 3 hours, every 6, up to every 24 hours, instead of a single daily slot.
